name: Mette
site: nuuday.dk · Telecom brands and business, Denmark
headline: Turn Nuuday’s usage data into customers who stay.
saw: Your homepage presents YouSee, Telmore, Hiper, Relatel, Eesy and TDC Erhverv side by side, with promotions, family offers and fibre, and every visitor sees the same front page.

Once a household is on a line or fibre, what they use, when they call and which offers they ignore is the strongest signal for the next upgrade or cancellation. Today it sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are typically built by hand, per segment, per month. The household about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per household from line usage, home internet and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment for each customer across YouSee, Telmore and Eesy, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match each household to the next offer
cases.text: Next best add-on per customer, such as a family line or fibre, triggered by what the household already uses. No more blanket mails to people already well served.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep each household using the service
cases.text: Personal nudges in email and on your homepage’s recommendations, chosen per customer from what they already use, so every household has a reason to engage again each week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
